Tier 4 LiveKit ingress cleanup contract
validation.blockerPolicy: Patch harness, evidence template, and docs until LiveKit ingress cleanup is explicit and validated.
validation.productionRisk: LiveKit ingress quota can be exhausted by stale Tier 4 resources even when app and provider routes are otherwise correct.
validation.whatItProves: Tier 4 harness contains DeleteIngress cleanup, evidence includes cleanupStatus/cleanupAttempted/cleanupDeleted, and cleanup utility exists.
validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not delete real provider ingress objects; run tier4:cleanup-livekit-ingress with env approval for live cleanup.

validation.name: Tier 4 LiveKit stale ingress cleanup utility
validation.command: npm run env:run -- -- bash -lc 'set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; TIER4_LIVEKIT_CLEANUP_APPROVED=1 npm run tier4:cleanup-livekit-ingress'
validation.blockerPolicy: Do not re-run Tier 4 create-ingress proof while LiveKit ingress quota is exhausted.
validation.productionRisk: Deleting wrong ingress could disrupt a real event; default utility only deletes safe tier4-auto ingress objects unless explicit ids are supplied.
validation.whatItProves: Stale Tier 4 LiveKit ingress objects were listed and deleted using provider API without exposing secrets.
validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not validate app behavior; it only restores provider quota capacity.

tierPolicy.tier1: Static/source/contract proof only. Does not prove browser, deployed runtime, or live providers.
tierPolicy.tier2: Local runtime/browser/self-spawn proof. Does not prove deployed runtime or live providers.
tierPolicy.tier3: Deployed postdeploy critical proof and safe provider boundary against explicit deployed URL. Does not prove real live provider operations.
tierPolicy.tier4: Final real live-provider operational proof with real credentials, operator evidence, provider resource/state proof, no-secret evidence scan, and cleanup/retention record.

zeroWarningPolicy.rule: No validator may emit advisory noise as a default pass state. Diagnostic checks must be INFO / NO VALIDATION or HARD FAIL when risk is real.
zeroWarningPolicy.reason: Warnings create operator noise and unclear release authority. Every validator must have explicit owner, tier, proof layer, and blocker policy.
